Maya: Preflight for small schema tweak (kv.record.meta nullable) + telemetry tag rename. Need cross-svc pins: API, Runtime, Router, Console. Quick align here.
Sam: I can pin API + Runtime and run API smoke.
Aaron: Router checks on me; need to validate header split predicate and ensure no header rewrite regressions.
Jen: Console ok; metric tag renamed telemetry.v2. I'll prepare release note and migration snippet.
Maya: Canary plan: 1% -> hold 15m -> 5% -> hold 20m -> 20% observe 30m -> ramp. Rollback triggers: 5xx +0.5% abs or p99 +30% sustained 5m. ops-oncall ack?
ops-oncall: ack. I'll watch SLOs and page if thresholds hit.
Sam: Proposed pins: API=v2.3.1-nullable, Runtime=v1.9.0-kv-quant, Router=hdr-split-2026-03, Console=v0.45.2.
Aaron: Router note: will push compat predicate. No KV eviction changes.
Maya: deploy-bot, create canary wave w/ manual holds after 1% and 5%.
deploy-bot: Scheduled wave db-wave-1732100000. Pins applied as listed. Steps created: 1% -> hold 15m -> 5% -> hold 20m -> 20% observe -> ramp.
Sam: API smoke checklist posted in thread: basic generate, p99 vs baseline, sample kv read/write.
Aaron: I'll run route-test.sh after router patch.
Maya: Contingency: if runtime pin fails, pin API+Router+Console, warm runtime nodes, then retry.
ops-oncall: Alerts set: 5xx >0.5% -> page; p99>+50% -> page. Muting noisy alerts for window.
Sam: Rollback steps: pause traffic, pin services to previous stable, flush caches if needed, open incident channel.
Maya: Dry-run pins at 01:30 UTC, start 02:00 UTC. If all green, Jen merge notes after 04:00 UTC.
Jen: Draft notes link: https://go/docs/releases/db-wave-1732100000 (draft). Adding migration toggle for analytics consumer.
Maya: Good. Locking plan. Will watch thread during rollout.
